newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - April 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - April 2.

text.p: The Washington Post carries the following major business stories on April 2:
WASHINGTON - American Online Inc is exploring a bid to buy computer online service rival CompuServe, industry sources said.
WASHINGTON - Pocket Communications inc, the second-highest bidder in a recent federal auction for wireless comunications licenses, has filed for bankruptcy protection.
WASHINGTON - NationsBank Corp., the nation's fourth largest bank, has become the first to ask federal regulators for permission to get into the real estate business.
TOYKO - Japanese authorities Tuesday acknowledged that Nippon Credit Bank Ltd. and Takushoku Bank Ltd were in dire financial condition and were closing down all overseas operations.

WASHINGTON - A federal grand jury in New York is investigating whether Teamsters Union President Ron Carey received illegal campaign kickbacks and employer contributions in last year's election for control of the union.
